List your personal access tokens, or the deploy tokens of a repository

Without --repo, list your personal access tokens (bound to your user).
With --repo &lt;name&gt;, list the deploy tokens of that repository (bound to it).

A list never contains a secret: a token is shown only when it is created or
rotated. 100 tokens are read per request; --limit stops after that many (0
means all).

```
rp token list [flags]
```

## Options

```
      --limit int     Stop after this many tokens (0 means all)
      --repo string   List the deploy tokens of this repository instead of your personal access tokens
```
